# ClearID Kft. — Identity verification agreement

ClearID Kft. provides identity and document verification for Project Bridge. The agreement expires on 2027-01-31. The service accepts a document image and returns a verification status through an API. HR approves the intended business use and Procurement maintains the signed commercial schedule. The current order covers employee onboarding appointments.

The provider records the time an attempt is accepted and the time a status is returned. An incomplete image is returned for correction without a completed verification result. The HR coordinator decides how to contact the applicant. The service desk must not ask an employee to email an identity document to an unapproved personal address as a shortcut.

Daily operational reports distinguish completed checks, rejected images and interrupted attempts. A request identifier follows an attempt through the support process. If a check is interrupted, support first confirms whether it was accepted before submitting it again. Repeated submission of an already completed check can create an unnecessary charge and a confusing appointment history.

Manual appointments require a named reviewer and a recorded reason. The provider can assist with a service investigation, but HR owns the employment decision. Copies retained temporarily for delivery are subject to the agreed deletion process. A corrected document image must be associated with the employee's existing appointment rather than a new employee record.

The December contract review will estimate the January workload and decide whether another fixed period is needed. An extension requires approval before the stated expiry; outstanding support tickets do not extend the service automatically. Finance has requested a separate invoice count for interrupted attempts that were resubmitted after a provider-side timeout.
